rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the 8-1 coalition together with a narrow, text-in-context opinion reading “otherwise” to tether §1512(c)(2) to evidence-integrity obstruction. Gorsuch/Thomas/Alito are the most likely separate writers to press lenity and anti-overbreadth themes, while Sotomayor is likely to dissent emphasizing the independent force of (c)(2)’s broad verbs and “official proceeding” limitation.
